title.narrative: Integrated Land Administration and Justice Services Project

description.narrative: The Project Development Objectives are to (i) improve functional integration of Croatia's land and justice institutions; and (ii) enhance services for citizens

The objective of the Integrated Land Administration and Justice Services Project for Croatia is to enhance digital services and functional integration of land administration and court institutions. There are five components to the project, the first component being integrated digital land registry and court services. This component will finance activities that support the digitization and integration of land registry court data and services. It will continue the digitization of paper land registry records to making them more resilient to disaster and more easily shareable through the JIS and other online systems. The second component is the integrated digital services of state registers and geospatial data. This component will support enhanced geospatial data. The infrastructure cadaster system needs to be updated with data from infrastructure geodetic reports (elaborates) from 13 regional COs (from 13 counties). The third component is the enhanced digital integration of land register and cadaster. Under third component, enhancements will be made to the JIS and One-Stop-Shop (OSS), such as: (i) improving data quality and maintenance; (ii) recording of real property prices; (iii) simplifying online access to the land registry; (iv) upgrading of mobile apps (My Properties); (v) simplifying the process of recording construction rights; (vi) further digitization of cadaster processes; and (vii) extension of JIS access to other relevant stakeholders. The fourth component is the integrated court, LRO and CO infrastructure. This component will provide rehabilitation of court, registry, and cadaster infrastructure to international and EU standards to support improved service delivery and establishment of a new structure for addressing appeals of land disputes. Finally, the fifth component is the institutional capacity building, policy analysis, and project management.
